content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Project Co-ordinator Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Project Co-ordinator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the TMC ACTREC recruitment is Project Co-ordinator. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Project Co-ordinator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Co-ordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Science/Maths/Statistics/Biology/Chemistry/Physics/Epidemiology/Population science or related fields, along with a Postgraduate diploma/certificate in cancer research/clinical research/cancer registry.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum experience required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 03 years of experience in Clinical research is required for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Project Co-ordinator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Co-ordinator post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 34000 to Rs. 40000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, Pincode: 410210.
